name: Hal Brennan
title: Chief Engineer
effect: Builds fast. Warns you when you cut corners
bio: Hal Brennan has built rockets for decades and trusts none of them. He speaks in short sentences and means every word.

hired: You hired me. Good. I've seen this movie before.
released: Your call. Check the welds twice.

name: Dev Okafor
title: Junior Engineer
bio: Dev Okafor is a junior engineer who gets excited about every bolt. He is not as fast as the veterans, but he is cheap and keen.
strength: Steady builder, easy on the budget

hired: Cool cool cool! I won't let you down.
released: Cool. Cool cool. Okay. See you around!

name: Inez Moreau
title: Quality Inspector
bio: Inez Moreau reads a checklist like a mystery novel. She always finds the one line that does not belong.
flaw: Slow, trusts only what she has tested

released: Noted. Please keep verifying without me.

name: Skye Patel
title: Meteorologist
bio: Skye Patel reads the sky better than most computers. She can make a storm forecast sound like a bedtime story.

hired: This is going to be a breeze. That forecast is looking up!
released: Looks like I'll blow away now. Good luck!

name: Marty Kowalski
title: Logistics Manager
bio: Marty Kowalski knows every shipper, truck and customs officer by name. His phone never stops ringing, and he somehow answers all of it.
flaw: Talks fast and panics a little

hired: Don't panic. Okay, panic a little. I'm on it.
released: Okay, okay. My phone's ringing. Bye!

name: Tasha Brooks
title: PR Lead
effect: Turns a week into extra budget
bio: Tasha Brooks can turn a hard week into a great headline. Donors and reporters both love her.
strength: Turns a week into extra budget

hired: Welcome to the team! That's a headline!
released: That's a wrap. I'll call it a new chapter.
